observations.description: Wide shot of the pitch showing players in red and light blue jerseys passing the ball in the midfield area. The scoreboard displays OSA 2 - CEL 1 with the clock around 66:58.

Continuation of the wide midfield play as the light blue team advances the ball towards the opponent's penalty area. A player in light blue takes a shot from outside the box, which is blocked by defenders, resulting in a corner kick. The scene cuts to close-ups of players' reactions, followed by a wide view of the corner kick setup with on-screen graphics showing probability percentages (22%, 70%, 8%).

The corner kick is taken into the penalty box. A player in a light blue jersey jumps and heads the ball into the net. The scoreboard updates to OSA 2 - CEL 2 at 68:04, and the text 'equalizer_goal_action' appears on screen as players celebrate.
